intro: Mining gathers ore and stone from veins and smelts the ore into bars at a forge. Blacksmithing and Engineering use both, so it pairs well with either.

Ranks: Apprentice at any level; Journeyman from skill 50, Expert from 125 and Artisan from 200, at the trainers in the capitals and the larger towns. The trainers in the starting areas teach only up to 75. Darnassus has no Mining trainer: the nearest is in Auberdine. On Zephras Isle the quest Harvesting Windstones offers Mining for Dummies, which teaches Mining.

The route smelts where smelting gives points (Copper to 65, Tin and Bronze to about 105, Iron to about 138) and mines everywhere else. Every ore can be mined on the loops or bought at the Auction House: the Materials setting decides. From 140 to 155 and from 175 no smelt gives points, so those stretches are mined.

Optional skill bonuses: Enchant Gloves - Mining (+2) or Advanced Mining (+5), the Goblin Mining Helmet (+5, Engineering 205 to wear), the Twilight Mine Light (+4, from A Miner Problem in the Riverglades) and the Miner's Cape (+2, Miner Johnson in The Deadmines). With +5, Iron Deposits can be mined from 120.

steps.tip: No character level needed. On Zephras Isle, Mining for Dummies from Harvesting Windstones teaches it too.
A tool: it stays in your bags, and every vein needs it.

steps.name: Find Minerals
steps.tip: Veins show on the minimap. Dying turns it off, and only one kind of tracking is on at a time.
Mining it raises your skill too; enough to smelt your way to 65.
Every bar gives a point up to 25. Keep 70 of the bars: Bronze takes them at 65.

steps.title: Copper
steps.tip: Only if the smelting left you short of 65.
Needs Mining skill 50. The trainers in the starting areas teach only up to 75.
Tin Veins need Mining skill 65.
Tin stops giving points at 75, but Bronze needs all 70 bars.
A Copper Bar and a Tin Bar each. You end up near 105.
Cave mobs respawn fast: worth it only well above their level.
Needs Mining skill 125.

Iron gives a point every time up to 130; you end up near 138.
No smelt gives points from 140 to 155.

Mithril Deposits need Mining skill 175.
